proposal.title: Convert Apple II to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: Apple II
before.description: Apple’s independent computer platform used in the project’s business-software, dealer-demonstration and compatibility work. Apple II/Disk II business configurations and Peachtree cooperation are modelled separately from Logix-branded Apple II expansion and video cards. This host identity does not introduce an unspecified hardware revision or a new Logix computer offering.

specification.description: Apple provides the Apple II host platform and retains its independent hardware roadmap.
